### PVsyst Modeling Now Includes Latest Tigo Product Lines


‍
We’ve updated our PVsyst integration guide to include Tigo’s newest optimizer product lines – the TS4-A 725W and the TS4-X series. The updated article walks you through adding these products to PVsyst for accurate system modeling.
‍


**Read the full guide here:**[Adding Tigo Optimizers to PVsyst](https://support.tigoenergy.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043707033-Adding-Tigo-optimizers-to-pvsyst) **.**
